wing_dihedral_delta_deg.lo.why: anhedral earned a one-sided comfort credit (f16 monotone -0.00048 at -3 deg; c172x noisy -0.0054 at -3 deg) with no lateral-stability cost in the scenarios; disabled until a spiral/Dutch-roll gate exists

wing_tc_root_scale.lo.why: at baseline structure the thin corner (with tip ratio 0.85) hit the EXISTING flutter hard fail inside the box (c172x <=0.85, T38 <=0.90, 737 <=0.875); thin wings earn no credit under the hinge energy term

identity_u_note: encoded all-defaults vector (NOT the zero vector: u=0 decodes to the lower bounds). decode(identity_u) == defaults exactly (tested).

helpers.encode: planform_b2.encode_shape_b2(model, genes_dict_or_None) -> np.ndarray[11] (legacy order (genes, model) accepted)

energy_export.out_key: evaluate(...)['energy'] (top level; NOT in terms / TERM_KEYS; in_cost=false)

energy_drag_increment.def: drag_increment_cd / cd_ref; exactly 0.0 at B2 default (B2 drag functions absent)

drag_increment_cd.def: sum_t(dD_B2 * V_true * dt) / sum_t(qbar*S0 * V_true * dt); dD_B2 = aero/coefficient/b2_dCD0 + b2_dCDcam + b2_dCDwave (lbf), one sample per JSBSim frame

cd_ref.def: baseline aircraft (<root>_v2, A1 masses, no B2) trimmed D0/(qbar S0) at the scenario IC; FROZEN in v2_results/p3b2a_energy_ref.json, key 'h0=<h0_ft>|kcas=<speed_kts>'; gene- and gain-independent; ref_source='frozen' (or 'computed' with the same rule for an IC not in the file)

energy_drag_ratio.def: informational: sum(D V dt) / (P_ref * t_flown), total aero drag work vs baseline trimmed drag power D0 V0 (gain-dependent, ~1.001-1.015 at baseline)

drag_work_ftlbf.def: sum(D V_true dt), total aero drag

throttle_sat_frac.def: fraction of frames with throttle cmd >= throttle_max - 1e-6 (informational; Phase-1 baselines 0-0.25)

speed_low_frac.def: fraction of frames with V_cas < v_target - 5 kt

energy_export.aggregates: evaluate()['energy'][<field>] = mean over status-ok scenarios; speed_hold_ok = all(); per_scenario list carries every field + status, ref_source
energy_export.speed_gaming: primary signal is a q.V-weighted drag COEFFICIENT increment: flying slower or saturating throttle does not lower it (unlike D.V). Speed loss itself is uncosted in sim.py (track = altitude only), so the speed_hold_ok / speed_deficit fields are exported for ER's guard term.
energy_export.not_included: trim drag of the camber dCm0 (elevator deflection) and any elastic-shape drag; hence the hinge (no credit for drag reductions)

energy_cost_recommendation.status: approved by Corleone 20:19 PT; thickness genes require it
energy_cost_recommendation.J_speed_guard: w_E[model] * 3 * max(0, speed_deficit_kts_mean - 2) / v_target_kcas   (power ~ V^3: equivalent drag of the uncosted speed loss; 0 at all 4 Phase-1 baselines, deficits 0.14-0.90 kt)
energy_cost_recommendation.weight_rule: Breguet exchange: +1 % drag ~ +1 % gross weight -> J_mass-equivalent = w_mass * (W_trim / baseline_flexible_lb) per unit fractional drag
